 Russian drone hits apartment building in Kharkiv
 16.11.2026 18:23 
 Ukrinform 
 A Russian drone has struck an apartment building in the Shevchenkivskyi district of Kharkiv. 
 According to Ukrinform, Kharkiv Mayor Ihor Terekhov reported this on Telegram .
 "The drone hit the apartment building at the level of the second floor," Terekhov said.
 According to him, more than 30 windows and approximately ten cars were damaged.
 Read also: Russian drone hits children's educational facility in Kharkiv 
 As Ukrinform reported, Russian forces struck the city of Balakliia in the Kharkiv region on the afternoon of November 16, killing one person and injuring five others.
